column3: Eastmere Water Authority – Quarterly Operations Report
Quarterly Operations Report, Second Quarter 2026
1. Summary

The Authority delivered 41.2 million cubic metres of treated water between April and June, 2.6% more than in the same quarter last year. Compliance with drinking-water standards stood at 99.97% across 4,812 samples. Leakage fell for the fourth consecutive quarter, helped by the completion of pressure management in three more zones.

2.2 Customer contacts
Contacts about discoloured water rose after the March mains flushing programme and have since returned to normal. The main reasons for contact were: 
billing and meter queries (38% of contacts);
discoloured water (29%), of which:
- customers on the North Ridge main (212 contacts);
- customers elsewhere in the network (97 contacts);
no supply or low pressure (17%);
other enquiries (16%).

4. Financial position

Cash reserves at 30 June were equivalent to 212 days of operating costs, comfortably above the minimum of 120 days set in the financial policy. No new borrowing was drawn during the quarter.
5. Recommendations
The Board is asked to note this report and to approve the following actions:
1. Release the contingency held for scheme T-212 once tenders are returned.
2. Extend pressure management to the remaining five zones during the next financial year.
3. Publish the leakage figures on the Authority website each quarter.
4. Approval of the scheme is subject to:
(a) a satisfactory review of the tender evaluation;
(b) confirmation of the funding profile.
The next report will cover the third quarter and will be published in October.
